description:
Starts a filing session for a US federal individual income tax return when the taxpayer asks to file. Input: none. Output: a continuationHandle that identifies this filing session in later calls, and the packet rules as text. This call receives no tax facts and creates no return and no link; the filing link comes with an accepted packet. A new filing session is also how a fresh link replaces one that expired or was left unfinished, through which nothing was filed or charged: the same packet sent on the new handle returns the new link.

Covered returns: one original tax year 2025 US federal individual income tax return (Form 1040 or 1040-SR, and some Form 1040-SS and Form 1040-NR situations), with no state or local return. The packet rules this call returns list each covered and refused situation.
name: create_filing_session
title: Start filing session
